title: Model-based action fuzz: seeded random user actions at mixed timings (set `layout`: New Column, Cmd-D, Split Down, Ctrl-`, close pane, divider drag, window resize, relaunch; set `full`: also Cmd-T, Cmd-N, closes, switches, typing, paste, a browser URL, close all), with every oracle after each burst
why: cmux-ad 2026-10-31 (Lawrence: "we need to fuzz greater for both correctness and speed"): one fuzzer with the smoke gate's action layer and oracles. A create that gives no terminal and no refusal, R3a (grid == fit == PTY == daemon), R3b (a new column never resizes an old one), focus != first responder, daemon != app topology, a main-thread stall over 100 ms in cmux code, a crash or a leak after close-all fails it; fuzz.py compares the speed marks against the base build.
source: scripts/journeys/fuzz.py (ext_fuzz.py); the seed and the sequence come from the journey options fuzz_seed, fuzz_count, fuzz_sequence, fuzz_budget_s, fuzz_mode

steps.title: the fuzz found no failure, the daemon agrees with the app, and the window is not blank
